content.short: trium Lab is building a Cardano social-media experience around customizable NFT-based accounts.
content.description: trium Lab describes Atrium as a social-media project coming to Cardano. User accounts are designed as customizable NFTs that can be leveled up and traded, while smart contracts can read profile NFT data as part of the platform experience. The project is positioned around on-chain identity and social interaction, with NFT accounts acting as the foundation for how users participate in the network.
content.meta: Find out about Atrium (ATRIUM) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
